simple.meaning: חֲלוֹם (chălôwm) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a dream.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 64 times across Genesis, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Judges, 1 Samuel, and 9 more, beginning at Genesis 20:3. Its contexts include family, family line, flock.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֲלוֹם (H2472).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: חֲלוֹם (chălôwm) / H2472 is traced through Genesis 20:3, Genesis 20:6, Genesis 31:10, Genesis 31:11 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H2472. chalom חֲלוֺם noun masculine Gen 37:10 dream ; — ׳ת absolute 37:5 +, construct 20:3 , חֲלֹם absolute 20:6 , construct 31:24 ; suffix חֲלוֺמִי 40:9 , 16 , חֲלֹמִי 41:17 , 22 , חֲלֹמוֺ 40:5 5 t.; plural חֲלֹמוֺת Jer 23:32 10 t. etc., + 7 t. suffix — dream 1 ordinary dream of sleep Job 7:14 ; 20:8 ; Psa 73:20 ; Eccl 5:2 ; 5:6 ; Isa 29:7 . 2 dreams with prophetic meaning , the lowest grade of prophecy (see Br MP 6 ): a. dream of Abimelek Gen 20:3 , 6 , of Jacob 31:10-11 , Laban 31:24 , Joseph 37:5-6 , 8 , 9 (twice in verse); 37:10 , 19 , 20 ; 42:9 , Pharaoh and his servants 40:5 (3 t. in verse); 40:8-9 , (twice in verse); 40:16 ; 41:7-8 , 11 (twice in verse); 41:12 (twice in verse); 41:15 (twice in verse); 41:17 , 22 , 25 , 26 , 32 ; of a lower order of prophets than Moses Num 12:6 , (all E, not elsewhere in Hexateuch), Job 33:15 , of Midianite Judg 7:13 (twice in verse); 7:15 , desired by Saul 1Sam 28:6 , 15 ; of Solomon 1Kin 3:5 , 15 ; of old men in latter days Joel 3:1 , of Nebuchadnezzar Dan 2:1-2 , 3 (twice in verse); Daniel וַחֲלֹמוֺת בְּכָלחָֿזוֺן הֵבִין 1:17 had understanding in all visions and dreams . b. of false prophets Deut 13:2 ; 13:4 ; 13:6 ; Jer 23:27-28 , (twice in verse); 23:32 ; 27:9 ; 29:8 ; Zech 10:2 .
